concerns.text: SC‑004 requires measuring the overall computational feasibility (total pipeline runtime ≤ 6 h and peak RAM ≤ 7 GB). No task in tasks.md records or verifies the aggregate runtime or total memory usage across all phases; only per‑tool memory checks (T005/T006) exist. Add a task (e.g., T014) that logs total execution time and maximum RAM consumption for the entire pipeline and asserts compliance with SC‑004.
